0.5 M EDTA stock solution To prepare 0.5 M EDTA (pH 8.0), dissolve 93 g of EDTA disodium salt in ~400 mL of deionized water in a 500 mL autoclavable screw-cap bottle with a magnetic stir bar. The EDTA will not dissolve until the pH is adjusted. Slowly add ~10 g of NaOH pellets while stirring until the pH reaches 8.

Once fully dissolved, transfer the solution to a 500 mL graduated cylinder, adjust to the final volume with deionized water, remove the stir bar, and return the solution to the bottle. Autoclave and store at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare 0.5 M EDTA stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve 93 g EDTA disodium salt in ~400 mL deionized water in a 500 mL autoclavable screw‑cap bottle, stir, then slowly add ~10 g NaOH pellets while stirring until pH reaches 8.0; bring volume to 500 mL with deionized water, autoclave, and store at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare 10 nm gold bead solution
steps.instruction: Centrifuge 300 µL BSA‑conjugated 10 nm gold nanoparticles at 16,100 × g for 30 min at 4 °C; discard supernatant without disturbing the pellet; gently resuspend pellet in 150 µL iso‑osmotic homogenization buffer by pipetting or brief vortexing; store at 4 °C and use within one week.

steps.title: Prepare iso‑osmotic homogenization buffer
steps.instruction: In a 500 mL autoclavable screw‑cap bottle, dissolve 54.77 g sucrose in ~400 mL deionized water while stirring; add 0.477 g HEPES and 1 mL of the 0.5 M EDTA stock solution; stir until fully dissolved and adjust pH to 7.4; bring final volume to 500 mL with deionized water.

steps.title: Anesthetize and euthanize rat
steps.instruction: Deeply anesthetize a 10‑week‑old Sprague‑Dawley rat (either sex) with isoflurane, then euthanize using a small‑animal decapitator.

steps.title: Dissect hippocampi in cold buffer
steps.instruction: Quickly remove fur and skull, extract the brain, and transfer it to a Petri dish containing ice‑cold homogenization buffer (kept on ice); isolate the hippocampi from both hemispheres.

steps.title: Weigh tissue and add homogenization buffer
steps.instruction: Weigh the paired hippocampi, place them into a 10‑mL Teflon‑head tissue grinder, and add 10 mL of ice‑cold homogenization buffer per gram of tissue.

steps.title: Homogenize tissue with overhead stirrer
steps.instruction: Homogenize the tissue using an overhead stirrer set to approximately 500 rpm for four strokes, each stroke lasting about 1–2 seconds.

steps.title: Centrifuge homogenate and collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the homogenate at 800 × g for 10 min at 4 °C; immediately pipette the supernatant off without disturbing the pellet and keep it on ice for downstream cryo‑EM grid preparation.

steps.title: Set Vitrobot parameters for vitrification
steps.instruction: Program the Vitrobot Mark III to 100 % humidity, 4 °C, blot time 3.5 s, blot total 1, blot offset –1.5, and wait time 6 s.

steps.title: Mix supernatant with gold beads 1:1
steps.instruction: Combine the collected supernatant with the 10 nm gold bead solution in a 1:1 volume ratio.

steps.title: Apply mixture to EM grids
steps.instruction: Place 4 µL of the supernatant‑gold bead mixture onto each Quantifoil R2/2 Cu 200 mesh EM grid.

steps.title: Blot and plunge grids into ethane
steps.instruction: Blot the grids according to the Vitrobot settings and immediately plunge them into liquid ethane that is cooled by liquid nitrogen.

steps.title: Store vitrified grids in liquid nitrogen
steps.instruction: Transfer the vitrified grids to a liquid‑nitrogen‑filled storage box and keep them at liquid‑nitrogen temperature until imaging.

steps.title: Load grids into Titan Krios microscope
steps.instruction: Insert the vitrified grids into a Titan Krios G4 microscope equipped with a Gatan K3 camera.

steps.title: Configure batch tomography acquisition
steps.instruction: Open Tomography 5 software and select batch tomography acquisition mode.

steps.title: Search for synaptosome structures at low mag
steps.instruction: At a search magnification of 4,800× (pixel size 3.69 nm), locate synaptosome or synaptoneurosome structures—identified by enclosed presynaptic compartments with vesicles and postsynaptic membranes with PSD.

steps.title: Refine and confirm tomography positions
steps.instruction: Set up batch tomography positions on identified structures, run the low‑dose refinement to acquire preview images, then double‑check high‑magnification exposure images to ensure the positions contain true synaptosomes or synaptoneurosomes before collection.

steps.title: Collect tilt series with voltage phase plate
steps.instruction: Acquire tilt series using a voltage phase plate at 26,000× magnification (pixel size 3.3 Å), defocus –1 to –2 µm, employing a dose‑symmetric scheme from 0° to ±60° in 2° increments.
